content:
It would be helpful to include what the authentication error message said, otherwise it's just guess work. It may have been a temporary network or server issue.

Navigate to settings > account name > fetching mail > incoming server. Tap next.

If the step doesn't show any error messages then no further action is needed.

So the authentication failure is coming from outgoing mail servers.

I'm still getting incoming mail without a problem.
creator: recinosx89

content:
Based on the information on https://support.apple.com/en-us/102525

Server = smtp.mail.me.com Security = StartTLS Port = 587 Authentication = normal password Username = your full email address Password = Same app specific password you used on the incoming settings page.

StartTLS is the correct security type for port 587
